content.article: This handbook covers every bonus of Longfu88, beginning with the Casino Welcome Bonus: 188% up to €2,088 plus 18 Free Spins, with 25x wagering on deposit plus bonus and 40x on Free Spins winnings. Players looking for the Longfu bonus find the offer families, terms, reloads, cashback and rewards on this page. The offers at Longfu88 are for players aged 18 or over, and the page is written for players from Malaysia.

All Bonus Families in One Place

The offers of Longfu88 fall into four families, which helps a reader find the right section before comparing amounts and terms:

  • Welcome offers: Casino Welcome Bonus, Live Casino Welcome Bonus and Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus.
  • Reload offers: Casino Weekend Reload and Casino Weekly Reload.
  • Cashback: Casino Weekly Cashback and Live Casino Cashback.
  • Rebates: Unlimited Casino Rebate, together with the rebates of the other game categories.

Every offer has its own terms and is activated in My Bonuses, so the conditions of each one need to be checked separately. The sportsbook keeps its own bonuses, which are covered further down the page.

Longfu88 Welcome Bonus: The Main Offer and Its Alternatives

Longfu88 treats the Casino Welcome Bonus as its main offer: a first-deposit casino bonus of 188% up to €2,088 plus 18 Free Spins for new registered players on the first qualifying deposit, with one welcome offer per account. The Casino Welcome Bonus and the Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus are alternative first-deposit offers, and the table sets all three welcome offers of Longfu88 side by side.

Offer Reward Minimum deposit Validity
Casino Welcome Bonus 188% up to €2,088 + 18 Free Spins €50 10 days from activation
Live Casino Welcome Bonus 125% up to €888 €30 7 days
Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus 188% up to 2,888 USDT 50 USDT 10 days

How to Claim the Casino Welcome Bonus

The claiming procedure at Longfu88 has four steps, from registration to completed wagering:

  1. Register an account and complete the required personal details.
  2. Make the first qualifying deposit.
  3. Activate the Casino Welcome Bonus in My Bonuses before placing any wagers.
  4. Play eligible casino games and complete the wagering before expiry.

A player activates the Casino Welcome Bonus in My Bonuses before placing any wager. The bonus is valid for 10 days from activation, so the wagering has to be completed within that period.

Wagering and Rules of the Welcome Bonus

The terms below belong to the Casino Welcome Bonus of Longfu88. Its wagering requirement applies to the deposit plus the bonus amount, and separately to the Free Spins winnings, so each part has its own multiple.

Term Value
Wagering 25x the deposit plus bonus amount
Free Spins wagering 40x Free Spins winnings
Validity 10 days from activation
Maximum bet €22.5 per spin
Maximum cashout 5x the initial bonus amount

Four further rules shape the offer. Neteller and Skrill deposits are excluded from this promotion, and only one promotional bonus may be active at a time. A withdrawal request before claiming or while the bonus is active can void promotional eligibility, and account verification may be required before promotional winnings are paid.

Is There a Promo Code?

The Brand Information of the casino lists no Longfu88 promo code for its offers, and this page names none. Offers are activated in My Bonuses instead. The Casino Welcome Bonus is activated there before the first wager, while every other offer is activated after its eligibility and deposit conditions are met. For players at Longfu88, My Bonuses is therefore the place where each listed offer is switched on.

Minimum Deposit of Every Offer at a Glance

The minimum deposit at Longfu88 depends on the offer, and the crypto offers are counted in USDT instead of euros.

Offer Minimum deposit
Casino Welcome Bonus €50
Live Casino Welcome Bonus €30
Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus 50 USDT
Casino Weekly Reload €30
Casino Weekly Crypto Reload 20 USDT
Casino Weekend Reload €50
Casino Weekend Crypto Reload 20 USDT
Casino Double Fortune: One-Day Reload Special €30
Casino Trick or Treat Pumpkin Bonanza €20
Casino Dragon Quest: Get Verified and Get Extra! €20

The general minimum deposit of the casino is not the minimum of an offer, so a player checks the amount of the offer first.

Reload Bonuses: Weekly, Weekend and One-Day

The reload offers at Longfu88 reward repeat deposits during the week or at the weekend.

Offer Reward Minimum deposit Wagering
Casino Weekly Crypto Reload 60% up to 1,000 USDT 20 USDT 30x deposit plus bonus
Casino Weekend Reload Up to €3,360 + 50 Free Spins €50 30x deposit plus bonus, 40x Free Spins winnings
Casino Weekend Crypto Reload 75% up to 750 USDT + 100 Free Spins 20 USDT 30x deposit plus bonus, 40x Free Spins winnings
Casino Double Fortune: One-Day Reload Special 50% up to €500 €30 30x deposit plus bonus

The weekly and weekend offers are valid for 7 days, while the Double Fortune special lasts 24 hours. The stake while wagering bonus funds is limited to €5 per spin, and a reload cannot be combined with another active casino bonus.

Free Spins: Weekly Reload and Seasonal Offers

Free spins come from three offers at Longfu88. First comes the Casino Weekly Reload, which gives 50 Free Spins for a minimum deposit of €30, with 40x winnings from Free Spins and a validity of 7 days. Next, the seasonal Casino Trick or Treat Pumpkin Bonanza offers up to 100 Free Spins from a minimum deposit of €20, with 40x Free Spins winnings. Third, the welcome bonus adds 18 Free Spins on the same 40x basis. Wagering is counted on the winnings of the spins.

Seasonal and Verification Campaigns

Campaigns come and go at Longfu88, so the promotions page of the casino shows the current list. The Casino Trick or Treat Pumpkin Bonanza offers up to 100 Free Spins from a €20 minimum deposit, with 40x Free Spins winnings and 7 days of validity. Players who complete the requested account verification receive a €10 bonus credit from Casino Dragon Quest: Get Verified and Get Extra!, which asks for €20, 30x the promotional credit and 7 days. Both campaigns limit the stake to €5 per spin while wagering bonus funds and cannot be combined with another active casino bonus.

Crypto Welcome and Reload Offers with USDT

The Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus at Longfu88 gives 188% up to 2,888 USDT for a first qualifying crypto deposit of at least 50 USDT, with 40x deposit plus bonus wagering, 10 days of validity and a maximum bonus wager of 5 USDT per spin. It is an alternative to the Casino Welcome Bonus as a first-deposit offer.

Offer Reward Minimum deposit Wagering
Casino Weekly Crypto Reload 60% up to 1,000 USDT 20 USDT 30x deposit plus bonus
Casino Weekend Crypto Reload 75% up to 750 USDT + 100 Free Spins 20 USDT 30x deposit plus bonus, 40x Free Spins winnings

Eligible cryptocurrencies are USDT, BTC, BCH, LTC, ETH, XRP and USDC.

Offers for Live Dealer Games

New players who start with live dealer games have their own welcome offer at Longfu88: the Live Casino Welcome Bonus of 125% up to €888 on the first qualifying deposit. It asks for a minimum deposit of €30 and wagering of 30x the deposit plus bonus, stays valid for 7 days and allows a maximum bet of €25. The Live Casino Cashback adds 25% up to €850 with 10x the credited cashback as wagering, based on real-money stakes less winnings in eligible Live Casino games. Last, the Unlimited Live Casino Rebate pays 1.0%, credited daily.

Cashback: Weekly, Live and by VIP Level

Cashback at Longfu88 returns part of the net losses of a week, and the Casino Weekly Cashback is its main form: up to 10% of weekly net casino losses, capped at €6,988. The week runs from Monday 00:00 UTC through Sunday 23:59 UTC, the minimum cashback is €4.5, and the player opts in for a four-week cycle. Wagering is 10x the cashback, and only real-money bets count, since bonus funds are excluded. The Live Casino Cashback gives 25% up to €850 with 10x the credited cashback as wagering. A higher VIP level raises the weekly percentage, as the table shows, while the VIP Program has its own page on Longfu88.

VIP level Cashback percentage Maximum
VIP Bronze 2% €1,888
VIP Silver 4% €2,388
VIP Gold 6% €2,988
VIP Platinum 8% €3,988
VIP Diamond 10% €6,988

Unlimited Rebates

A rebate at Longfu88 returns a share of qualifying settled real-money wagering on a game category every day.

Rebate Rate
Unlimited Casino Rebate 0.9%
Unlimited Live Casino Rebate 1.0%
Unlimited P2P Rebate 0.8%
Unlimited Lottery Rebate 1.0%

The rebate is credited daily to the rewards balance and carries 1x wagering on the credited rebate.

Rewards Area: Bonus Crab, Wheel of Fortune and Coin Shop

The rewards area at Longfu88 adds game-like features to the bonuses, and Coins are the currency of one of them:

  • Bonus Crab: claim qualifying picks to open a crab reward and reveal a casino prize.
  • Wheel of Fortune: spend an eligible spin or Coins to rotate a prize wheel.
  • Challenges: complete qualifying gambling tasks to earn listed rewards.
  • Collections: collect campaign items by completing qualifying activity.
  • Coin Shop: exchange earned Coins for reward items and bonus credits up to €4,500.

Sportsbook Offers and Qualifying Odds

The sportsbook of Longfu88 has its own bonuses, with a lower wagering multiple than the casino offers.

Offer Reward Minimum deposit Wagering
Sport First Deposit Bonus 100% up to €1,888 €50 8x deposit plus bonus
Sport Crypto Welcome Bonus 100% up to 200 USDT 20 USDT 8x deposit plus bonus
Sport Weekly Reload Bonus 50% up to €2,500 €50 8x deposit plus bonus
Sport Weekend Reload Bonus 50% up to €3,750 €50 8x deposit plus bonus

Only settled qualifying sports bets count toward the wagering. Single bets need odds of at least 2.00 and each accumulator selection at least 1.50, while voided and cashed-out bets do not qualify. The offers are valid for 30 days, so the wagering has to be completed within that period. Qualifying accumulators can also use the Parlay Boost, which adds up to 100% extra winnings.

Documents and Checks Before Payout

Account verification may be required before promotional winnings are paid at Longfu88, and a withdrawal request before claiming a bonus or while it is active can void the promotional eligibility. The documents involved are:

  • Government-issued photo ID or passport
  • Proof of residential address
  • Proof of ownership of a payment method
  • Source of funds or wealth documents when requested

The submission window is up to 30 days when requested, and the review takes up to 10 days after a complete document set is received.

Bonus Terms and Safer Play

Bonuses at Longfu88 are for players aged 18 or over who gamble only where it is lawful. The terms of an offer, such as wagering, maximum bet and validity, should be read before the player accepts it, because cancelling the promotion forfeits bonus funds and unconverted promotional winnings. Self-assessment questions help players identify possible gambling-related harm, and the support organisations include GamCare, Gamblers Anonymous and Gambling Therapy.

Claiming Bonuses on a Phone

The responsive Longfu88 website works in the browser of a smartphone or tablet. Bonuses are among its mobile features, next to the casino, the sportsbook, account access, deposits and withdrawals, so a phone covers both the offers and the payments around them. The mobile page of the site covers access in more detail.

faqs.question: What is the minimum first deposit for the welcome bonus at Longfu88?
faqs.answer: The Casino Welcome Bonus asks for a first deposit of at least €50.

faqs.question: Is a promo code needed?
faqs.answer: No promo code is listed for the offers, which are activated in My Bonuses instead.

faqs.question: How many promotional bonuses can be active at once?
faqs.answer: Only one promotional bonus may be active at a time.

faqs.question: Which payment methods are excluded from the welcome bonus?
faqs.answer: Neteller and Skrill deposits are excluded from the Casino Welcome Bonus.

faqs.question: What happens if a withdrawal is requested before claiming or while a bonus is active?
faqs.answer: The promotional eligibility can be voided.

faqs.question: Can verification be required for bonus winnings?
faqs.answer: Yes, account verification may be required before promotional winnings are paid.

faqs.question: How is the weekly cashback claimed?
faqs.answer: The player opts in for a four-week cycle and then activates the credited cashback in My Bonuses.

faqs.question: What does the Coin Shop give?
faqs.answer: It exchanges earned Coins for reward items and bonus credits up to €4,500.
